v2-serve-v1-reopen.description: Policy simulation for the serve-session runner: every detected speech run is admitted and cancels any current reply; input availability is withdrawn while Lamp's playback is owed and reported again 100 ms after the turn finishes, like V1-baseline's tail. Not a measurement of the Lamp.

scenarios.description: Eight context-linked turns in one serve runtime and one provider session: a question, two follow-ups waiting for real readiness, an interruption during output, a follow-up superseded by a correction before output, and two more turns. Cached speech only.
